name: Kino Shizuku
source:
The only daughter of a small Japanese style diner in the shopping district. Lives with her father. She is an honest, pure, and serious girl who works hard at everything she does. She actively helps out at the restaurant, but since she can't cook, she works as a server.  She never forgets to thank the customers with a smile.

Her father had gone out to buy groceries and has not returned, so she has no choice but to pay rent due to not knowing his bank book or account. So she and Masaru try their best to keep the store open until her father returns. She and Kanade Maihara are friends who go to the same school.

"I will keep this shop alive until my father comes home."
